newsitem.title: USA: Bartow, Fla, approves $40.6 million budget.
newsitem.headline: Bartow, Fla, approves $40.6 million budget.

text.p: Florida's Bartow City Commission unanimously adopted a $40.6 million budget that calls for no tax or electric rate increases for fiscal 1997, the Tampa Tribune reported Wednesday.

The bulk of the revenues, $27.4 million, will come from the sale of electricity that the city buys wholesale from Florida Power Corp, a unit of Florida Progress Corp, and resells on the city's distribution system.
The electricty fund is projected to show a profit of $6.1 million, which is to be transferred to the general fund to pay most of the city's operating expenses.
The budget includes two construction projects, a $1.2 million city library and a $1.26 million electrical substation in southwest Bartow.
